name: Village Square
description: The open heart of the village, with a stone fountain, benches, and a view of the cafe and clinic fronts.

name: Village Clinic
description: A small clinic on the square. Waiting room at the front; dispensary and treatment room behind the reception desk.

name: Clinic Dispensary
description: A locked room behind the clinic reception. Medication cabinet, prescription log, the sink where pills are prepared.

name: Bench by the Fountain
description: Elias's habitual bench beside the stone fountain — where he is found collapsed.

name: Hobbs Cafe
description: The village cafe. Clara opens at 18:00. The window faces the square bench.

name: Owen Price's House & Yard
description: Owen's house and builder's timber yard on the far side of the square.

name: Flat above Hobbs Cafe
description: Clara's flat above the cafe, reached by a side stair.

name: Elias's Bench
description: The specific bench in the village square where Elias always sits, facing the clinic and cafe.
